svg.font-family: 'Roboto Mono', ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, 'DejaVu Sans Mono', monospace
svg.title: 100 steps per trip from Python
svg.desc: One call to the jitted pmap update runs the same program on both V100s. An outer lax.scan runs 10 blocks, each block is an inner lax.scan of 10 steps that calls value_and_grad of the FBPINN loss and adds up the gradients, then the gradients are divided by 10 and one optax update is applied. Inside every forward pass a psum over the devices axis adds u_sum and w_sum across the two GPUs over NVLink. The timeline shows one host dispatch, 100 steps per GPU with 10 optimizer updates and a sync tick every step, next to a plain Python loop that would dispatch 100 times.
svg.text: One dispatch runs 100 steps on both GPUs, with an NVLink all-reduce inside every forward pass.
same program on both GPUs, pmap axis "devices"

grads = grads + g, loss = loss + l
